answer: Meadow-inlet beacon heartbeat bond: each agent locks 70 credits on a sable-sealed sensor on a meadow plot at the inlet. A random beacon draws 10% each epoch; a drawn sensor must show a heartbeat log of fuel burned all epoch, or its bond burns. A rented-sensor ring fails: one log cannot cover two plots. Fuel is 12 per epoch: 1,000 fakes burn 12,000 an epoch plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 12 an epoch, keeps its bond.
